title: Event Campaign & Visual Communication
description: Designing consistent event graphics across different formats while protecting source photography and keeping the message easy to understand.
question: How can one visual identity stay recognizable across social, presentation and print formats without losing information or quality?
design: Used typography, hierarchy, photography, layout adaptation and production-ready exports to coordinate campaign visuals across varied placements. This summary deliberately avoids publishing client assets without approval.
focus: Strong type hierarchy and restrained visual treatment
Reusable visual components across changing aspect ratios
Preserving supplied photography and identity assets
Quality checks for screen and print export
reflection: A strong design is not just beautiful in one crop. It keeps communicating as requirements and formats change.
